Good problem solving and code debugging skills.

Extensively worked on Oracle XML Publisher Reports with sources based Oracle Reports and Good Knowledge PLSQL and DATA TEMPLATE.
Extensively worked with FND APIs and Standard APIs in developing of RICE Components.
Good Technical Development skills in developing RICEW Components of Oracle Applications E-Business Suite using SQL, PL/SQL and Reports and Forms.
Strong knowledge in Application Object Library (AOL) module.
Preparing AIM Documents like MD200,CF250 and BR100.Explain Plan.
Strong Database architecture understanding and extensive experience writing database objects like Procedures, Packages, Exceptions and Cursors in PL/SQL.
Excellent skills in Oracle (SQL, PL/SQL, Reports 10g,Forms 10g).
Proficient in writing stored procedures, Packages, functions using SQL & PL/SQL.
Extensively worked on PLSQL Collections and advanced PLSQL Concepts.
Knowledge in Unix Commmands
Good analytical and communication skills with experience in client handling.

Around 12+ years of Design/Consulting/Implementation experience in advanced software  design,development methodologies and niche technologies in Enterprise Application Services.
Working as Senior Software Engineer at Oracle from Oct 2021 till Present
Worked as a Information Technology Analyst at Tata Consultancy Services, Mumbai from Feb 2016
